question: Has the identity of Bitcoin's creator, Satoshi Nakamoto, been credibly and publicly confirmed as of July 21, 2026?
outcomes: Not confirmed — no public, reliable data available

model.prompt_context: Resolve as 'Confirmed -- single individual' if, by Jul 21, 2026, a specific named person has been publicly and credibly verified as the sole creator of Bitcoin through cryptographic proof (e.g. a signed message from a known Satoshi wallet) or near-unanimous consensus among major authoritative outlets (e.g. NYT, Reuters, AP). Resolve as 'Confirmed -- group of individuals' if the same standard of verification applies to a named group of people acting together. Resolve as 'Not confirmed -- no public, reliable data available' if neither of the above conditions is met as of that date.
